title: 2024-25 Panini NBA Hoops Red #74 Norman Powell Los Angeles Clippers Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2024-25 Panini NBA Hoops sports trading card featuring Norman Powell of the Los Angeles Clippers. It is a Red parallel numbered out of 75 cards in the set. The card is part of the base set and manufactured by Panini for the National Basketball Association (NBA). The card number is 74.
